name: What pool remodel questions should I ask before hiring a contractor in LA?

mainEntity.name: What pool remodel questions should I ask before hiring a contractor in LA?
mainEntity.text: What pool remodel questions should I ask before hiring a contractor in LA?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a pool remodel contractor in Los Angeles, ask questions that reveal both capability and scope clarity. The most important topics are licensing, insurance, prior pool remodel experience, permit handling, and whether the quote includes demolition, disposal, surface preparation, and cleanup. You should also ask what materials will be used, which brands are specified, and how warranty coverage works for workmanship and equipment. It is equally important to understand the change-order process. Pool remodels often uncover hidden issues after demolition, so the contractor should explain how surprises will be priced and approved. Ask for a detailed scope that separates optional upgrades from required repairs so you can compare bids accurately. Local experience matters because Los Angeles-area cities can differ in permit expectations, inspection timing, and typical backyard access constraints. A contractor who has completed similar projects in your area is better prepared to anticipate those issues. The best estimate is clear, itemized, and specific enough that you can tell exactly what is included and what is not.

Also ask whether the contractor has handled pool remodels in your specific city and whether the estimate includes demolition, disposal, and cleanup.
